Android app for the Ninebot MAX G3. Install `g3-connect.apk` on Android 8 or newer. Updates 1.0 in place.

## New in 1.1

- **Show pairing key:** "Pairing-Schlüssel anzeigen" in the scooter card shows the key the app created when pairing with the Power button, with a copy button. Use it to connect the web app with the same key or to keep a backup. Anyone with the key can connect to your scooter, so keep it private.
- The web app now also shows the key in use after connecting (under "Verbindungseinstellungen"), not only right after a new pairing.

Coming from G3 Connect Beta or G3 Maps Bridge: uninstall that first (new signature since 1.0) and pair again.

Setup: [android-bridge/README.md](https://github.com/xuynix1337/g3-connect/blob/main/android-bridge/README.md).
